code='''from collections import deque
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda c:sum(v==c for row in grid for v in row))
    seen=set(); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]!=bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]; edge=False
        while q:
          y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x)); edge |= y==0 or x==0 or y==h-1 or x==w-1
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
        if not edge:
          for y,x in comp: out[y][x]=2
    return out
'''
